metadata.warning: Dense interpolated vertices are not observed historic positions. Read feature and segment evidence labels.

properties.title: First U.S. transcontinental railroad
properties.why_famous: The Central Pacific and Union Pacific joined at Promontory Summit, linking the U.S. rail networks.
properties.route_summary: Separate ceremonial approaches from Sacramento and Omaha to Promontory Summit.
properties.geometry_note: Two approach corridors, not a single coast-to-coast train. Promontory's original grade was later bypassed; city anchors are approximate.
properties.description: Two approach corridors, not a single coast-to-coast train. Promontory's original grade was later bypassed; city anchors are approximate.
properties.overview: The Central Pacific and Union Pacific joined at Promontory Summit, linking the U.S. rail networks.

properties.title: Trans-Siberian through service
properties.why_famous: The Amur completion made possible a railway journey from Moscow to the Pacific entirely through the Russian Empire rather than Manchuria.
properties.geometry_note: Uses the pre-1917 southern approach and old Circum-Baikal line, not the post-1956 northern route. Station anchors are approximate; a 1916 train timetable remains to be confirmed.
properties.description: Uses the pre-1917 southern approach and old Circum-Baikal line, not the post-1956 northern route. Station anchors are approximate; a 1916 train timetable remains to be confirmed.
properties.overview: The Amur completion made possible a railway journey from Moscow to the Pacific entirely through the Russian Empire rather than Manchuria.

properties.title: Inaugural Express d'Orient
properties.why_famous: Its luxurious Paris to Constantinople connection became one of the best-known journeys in railway history.
properties.route_summary: Paris–Vienna–Bucharest–Giurgiu by rail; ferry to Ruse; train to Varna; ship to Constantinople.
properties.geometry_note: Four modes are separated. The October 1883 journey was not a through train to Constantinople. Railway alignments and Black Sea ship path are indicative.
properties.description: Four modes are separated. The October 1883 journey was not a through train to Constantinople. Railway alignments and Black Sea ship path are indicative.
properties.overview: Its luxurious Paris to Constantinople connection became one of the best-known journeys in railway history.

properties.title: Tōkaidō Shinkansen opening
properties.why_famous: The first high-speed railway transformed intercity travel.
properties.geometry_note: Station anchors follow the dedicated high-speed corridor; line curvature is simplified between stations.
properties.description: Station anchors follow the dedicated high-speed corridor; line curvature is simplified between stations.
properties.overview: The first high-speed railway transformed intercity travel.

properties.title: Stockton and Darlington inaugural train
properties.why_famous: An early public railway carried passengers behind a steam locomotive.
properties.source_title: National Railway Museum — Shildon and Locomotion
properties.geometry_note: Historic station and junction locations are approximate; several original grade sections are no longer in use.
properties.description: Historic station and junction locations are approximate; several original grade sections are no longer in use.

properties.title: Liverpool and Manchester Railway opening
properties.why_famous: The first major steam-powered intercity railway established the modern railway pattern.
properties.source_title: Science Museum Group — Liverpool and Manchester Railway
properties.geometry_note: Original Liverpool and Manchester terminal sites and some approaches differ from modern service lines.
properties.description: Original Liverpool and Manchester terminal sites and some approaches differ from modern service lines.
properties.overview: The first major steam-powered intercity railway established the modern railway pattern.

properties.title: Canadian Pacific inaugural through passenger train
properties.why_famous: The first through passenger service connected eastern Canada with the Pacific coast.
properties.geometry_note: The Rogers Pass anchors represent the original summit grade rather than later tunnels; eastern and western sections are station-level corridors.
properties.description: The Rogers Pass anchors represent the original summit grade rather than later tunnels; eastern and western sections are station-level corridors.
properties.overview: The first through passenger service connected eastern Canada with the Pacific coast.

properties.title: Flying Scotsman first nonstop run
properties.why_famous: The first nonstop London to Edinburgh scheduled train used a crew change while moving.
properties.geometry_note: East Coast Main Line station anchors show the corridor; intermediate stops are geographic waypoints, not scheduled stops on the nonstop run.
properties.description: East Coast Main Line station anchors show the corridor; intermediate stops are geographic waypoints, not scheduled stops on the nonstop run.
properties.overview: The first nonstop London to Edinburgh scheduled train used a crew change while moving.

properties.title: Lincoln funeral train
properties.why_famous: The funeral train carried Abraham Lincoln through cities where large crowds paid their respects.
properties.source_title: Library of Congress — Lincoln's Long Journey Home
properties.geometry_note: City sequence is documented, but interchange tracks, station approaches, and nineteenth-century rights of way are schematic.
properties.description: City sequence is documented, but interchange tracks, station approaches, and nineteenth-century rights of way are schematic.
properties.overview: The funeral train carried Abraham Lincoln through cities where large crowds paid their respects.

properties.title: Metropolitan Railway opening
properties.why_famous: London opened the world's first underground railway.
properties.geometry_note: Cut-and-cover tunnel corridor; historic Paddington and Farringdon Street termini differ from modern station geometry.
properties.description: Cut-and-cover tunnel corridor; historic Paddington and Farringdon Street termini differ from modern station geometry.
properties.overview: London opened the world's first underground railway.

properties.title: First Indian passenger train
properties.why_famous: The first public passenger service began India's railway era.
properties.geometry_note: Bori Bunder site is approximate and is not the footprint of the later CSMT building.
properties.description: Bori Bunder site is approximate and is not the footprint of the later CSMT building.
properties.overview: The first public passenger service began India's railway era.

properties.title: Japan's first railway
properties.why_famous: The Shinbashi to Yokohama line marked Japan's railway age and rapid industrial modernization.
properties.geometry_note: Historic reclaimed shoreline and original Shinbashi/Yokohama sites differ from today's main stations.
properties.description: Historic reclaimed shoreline and original Shinbashi/Yokohama sites differ from today's main stations.
properties.overview: The Shinbashi to Yokohama line marked Japan's railway age and rapid industrial modernization.

properties.title: Darjeeling Himalayan Railway opening
properties.why_famous: Its mountain line climbs from the plains to Darjeeling through loops and reverses.
properties.geometry_note: 1881 origin is Siliguri, not later New Jalpaiguri. Batasia Loop was added in 1919 and is deliberately excluded; old Ghum–Darjeeling curves need archival tracing.
properties.description: 1881 origin is Siliguri, not later New Jalpaiguri. Batasia Loop was added in 1919 and is deliberately excluded; old Ghum–Darjeeling curves need archival tracing.
properties.overview: Its mountain line climbs from the plains to Darjeeling through loops and reverses.

properties.title: Florida Overseas Railroad first train
properties.why_famous: Henry Flagler's railroad connected Key West to Florida's mainland across the sea.
properties.geometry_note: Island and bridge anchors follow the historic railroad corridor; roads reused only some railroad structures after the 1935 hurricane.
properties.description: Island and bridge anchors follow the historic railroad corridor; roads reused only some railroad structures after the 1935 hurricane.
properties.overview: Henry Flagler's railroad connected Key West to Florida's mainland across the sea.

properties.title: Suffrage Special
properties.why_famous: Suffragists toured western states by rail to recruit voters for a federal amendment.
properties.route_summary: Washington to documented western stops and back; geometry currently shows only verified short runs.
properties.source_title: Library of Congress — Suffrage Special itinerary
properties.geometry_note: Only documented Kansas and Colorado station sequences are drawn. The complete 38-day itinerary and exact railroads require a full reading of the contemporary itinerary before connecting these fragments into one line.
properties.description: Only documented Kansas and Colorado station sequences are drawn. The complete 38-day itinerary and exact railroads require a full reading of the contemporary itinerary before connecting these fragments into one line.
properties.overview: Suffragists toured western states by rail to recruit voters for a federal amendment.

properties.title: First Ghan to Stuart
properties.why_famous: The narrow-gauge route finally reached the Red Centre and became an Australian rail icon.
properties.geometry_note: Follows the old Oodnadatta alignment, not the modern western route to Darwin. Port Augusta rail junction and original northern stops are approximate.
properties.description: Follows the old Oodnadatta alignment, not the modern western route to Darwin. Port Augusta rail junction and original northern stops are approximate.

properties.title: Mallard steam speed record
properties.why_famous: LNER Mallard set the world speed record for a steam locomotive on Stoke Bank.
properties.geometry_note: The 126 mph point was south of Little Bytham, near milepost 90¼; station anchors simplify line curves.
properties.description: The 126 mph point was south of Little Bytham, near milepost 90¼; station anchors simplify line curves.
properties.overview: LNER Mallard set the world speed record for a steam locomotive on Stoke Bank.

properties.title: California Zephyr first run
properties.why_famous: Its dome cars and spectacular Rocky Mountain and Sierra scenery made the streamliner legendary.
properties.route_summary: Oakland–Feather River Canyon–Salt Lake City–Moffat Tunnel–Denver–Chicago.
properties.geometry_note: Original Western Pacific route via Feather River is used, not the modern Amtrak Donner Pass route. City and junction anchors simplify historic tracks.

properties.title: The Canadian inaugural service
properties.why_famous: Canadian Pacific's stainless steel streamliner became an icon of transcontinental passenger travel.
properties.source_title: VIA Rail — 70 years of The Canadian
properties.geometry_note: Original Canadian Pacific corridor via Calgary; today's VIA Canadian uses a substantially different western route. Two eastern origins merge near Sudbury.
properties.description: Original Canadian Pacific corridor via Calgary; today's VIA Canadian uses a substantially different western route. Two eastern origins merge near Sudbury.
properties.overview: Canadian Pacific's stainless steel streamliner became an icon of transcontinental passenger travel.

properties.title: Indian Pacific inaugural service
properties.why_famous: The first unbroken rail passenger journey linked Australia's Indian and Pacific Ocean coasts.
properties.geometry_note: Cross-continent station and junction anchors; 1970 approaches and exact timetable need archival confirmation.
properties.description: Cross-continent station and junction anchors; 1970 approaches and exact timetable need archival confirmation.
properties.overview: The first unbroken rail passenger journey linked Australia's Indian and Pacific Ocean coasts.

properties.title: TGV Sud-Est passenger opening
properties.why_famous: The TGV brought high-speed rail to European intercity service.
properties.route_summary: Paris Gare de Lyon–initial LGV Sud-Est section–Lyon.
properties.geometry_note: 1981 LGV section and conventional approaches are schematic; the entire later LGV was not yet open.
properties.description: 1981 LGV section and conventional approaches are schematic; the entire later LGV was not yet open.
properties.overview: The TGV brought high-speed rail to European intercity service.

properties.title: Eurostar first service
properties.why_famous: Passenger trains began running directly between London and mainland Europe through the Channel Tunnel.
properties.route_summary: London Waterloo–Folkestone–Channel Tunnel–Calais–Lille–Paris Gare du Nord.
properties.geometry_note: Uses Waterloo and the pre-HS1 British network. Channel Tunnel portals are approximate, and French high-speed alignment is station-level.
properties.description: Uses Waterloo and the pre-HS1 British network. Channel Tunnel portals are approximate, and French high-speed alignment is station-level.
properties.overview: Passenger trains began running directly between London and mainland Europe through the Channel Tunnel.

properties.title: Qinghai–Tibet Railway opening
properties.why_famous: The line gave Tibet its first railway and crossed extreme high-altitude terrain.
properties.geometry_note: Known stations and high pass follow the railway corridor; exact permafrost viaduct geometry omitted.
properties.description: Known stations and high pass follow the railway corridor; exact permafrost viaduct geometry omitted.
properties.overview: The line gave Tibet its first railway and crossed extreme high-altitude terrain.

properties.title: Bernina Railway opening
properties.why_famous: The mountain railway crosses the Alps without a summit tunnel and is now World Heritage.
properties.geometry_note: Station anchors trace the historic corridor but simplify loops, viaducts, and street running through Tirano.
properties.description: Station anchors trace the historic corridor but simplify loops, viaducts, and street running through Tirano.
